description: This file defines the AwsException class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing exceptions thrown during AWS command execution. It includes properties for request, response, error details, and methods for retrieving this information.

classes.name: AwsException
classes.description: Represents an AWS SDK exception with detailed context about failed commands and responses, supporting error handling and diagnostics.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new AwsException instance with message, command, context, and optional previous exception.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including class, message, and parent exception details.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command object that was executed when the exception was thrown.

methods.name: getAwsErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the AWS-specific error message, if available.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the error.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response received, if any.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result object associated with the error.

methods.name: isConnectionError
methods.description: Indicates whether the exception was caused by a connection error.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP status code from the response, if available.

methods.name: getAwsRequestId
methods.description: Returns the AWS request ID related to the error.

methods.name: getAwsErrorType
methods.description: Returns the AWS error type.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the AWS error code.

methods.name: getAwsErrorShape
methods.description: Returns the error shape information.

methods.name: getTransferInfo
methods.description: Retrieves transfer-related information or specific statistics.

methods.name: setTransferInfo
methods.description: Sets the transfer information array.

methods.name: isMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the maximum retries threshold has been exceeded.

methods.name: setMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating maximum retries have been exceeded.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific data key exists in the exception.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a data value by key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the exception's data.
